Card Q&A.a: It refers to when there are 2 or more cards with the same level among all of the stacked cards. Examples include when a level 5 Digimon has a level 5 digivolution card or when a level 6 Digimon has 2 level 5 digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: What does "if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards" mean, exactly?

Effect: [When Digivolving] ＜Draw 1＞ and trash 1 card in your hand. Then, if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't suspend until their turn ends.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with the [Night Claw], [Light Fang] or [Galaxy] trait would be deleted, by trashing 2 same-level cards from its digivolution cards, it isn't deleted.
Special Digivolution Condition: [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Night Claw]/[Light Fang]/[CS] trait: Cost 3
